build_projectaria_tools_extension: build the projectaria_tools C++ extension using CMake and setuptools build_ext
create_cmake_extension: create a CMakeExtension with a given name and source directory for CMake-based builds
configure_cmake_build: configure the CMakeBuild command to compile native extensions with Ninja or MSVC generators
get_package_version: get the package version string from version.txt in the project root directory
install_projectaria_tools: install the projectaria_tools package with pip using the setup.py entry point
